description: Few-shot examples for C. elegans embryo perception system

early.description: Early embryo development - cell division visible, oval shape

comma.description: Comma stage - embryo begins to elongate, comma-like shape

pretzel.description: Pretzel stage - embryo folded into pretzel shape

3fold.description: 3-fold stage - embryo tightly folded, movements may be visible

hatching.description: Active hatching - breach in eggshell, worm emerging

hatched.description: Hatching complete - empty eggshell or worm fully emerged

dead_embryo.description: Embryo that has stopped developing - no movement, unchanged morphology

blank_technical.description: Blank frame due to technical issue - imaging error, focus problem

blank_biological.description: Blank frame after hatching - worm has left field of view
